data.body: Evidence (Nov 20 2026, commit on origin/main 8e1d15e664f). Before: new census test fails naming tests/unit/test_review_bot.py:1798, :1827, :1874 timeout(3). Under the 1.6 s-per-start git shim the 3 webhook tests hit +++ Timeout +++ in setup; after raising to 30 s they pass under the shim (setup 3.80 s, 1.64 s; 3 passed in 15.05 s) and without it (130 passed). Slot-run make verify (unsandboxed, load ~18-23): default tier 21538 passed, 0 pytest-timeout expiries, 3 errors that were all 'New entries appeared in REPO_ROOT: r2.yml' — a scratch file this session wrote into the worktree root by mistake during the run and then deleted, not a product or test defect. Integration tier then run directly with the same command line: 226 passed, 2 skipped. Log: worktree f2-verify-parity .rebar/scratch/s05f74084-f2/make-verify-gelding.log and integration-gelding.log.
